inputs_used: Scan Report-5 focused main.py scan findings

security_policy.policy_basis: No SECURITY.md was found. Boundary assessment used README/repository purpose, previous architecture threat model, and Flask route evidence in main.py.

summary.deduplication_result: Scan Report-4 and Scan Report-5 findings are duplicate reports of the same 11 implementation-backed issues, with one scope expansion for reflected XSS in Scan Report-5.

triage_method.decision_basis: Each finding was checked against source location, route reachability, attacker-controlled input, security controls, sink semantics, impact, counterevidence, and whether source code had changed since the scan reports.
triage_method.dedup_basis: Findings were consolidated only when they had the same vulnerable operation or broken control, same source-to-sink path, and overlapping code locations. Similar severity or category alone was not used for merging.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No authentication, sandbox, parser, allowlist, or restricted globals before eval.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Flask app running and /evaluate reachable.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same eval sink, route, root cause, and evidence as MAINPY-001.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No effective control before Python interpreter execution.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Flask app running and route reachable.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-001; both describe request.form['expression'] reaching eval at main.py:379.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No command argument separation or hostname validation before os.popen.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Flask app running, shell command environment available.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same command string construction and popen sink as MAINPY-002.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No shell=False equivalent, argument list, or input validation.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Flask app running, /lookup reachable.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-002; both identify address concatenation into os.popen.

input_finding_assessments.reachability: Reachable through GET /cookie when the client supplies a value cookie.
input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Base64 is only encoding; there is no signature, MAC, or safe serializer.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker can set their own cookie and request /cookie.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same pickle.loads on client cookie as MAINPY-003.

input_finding_assessments.reachability: Reachable through GET /cookie with a client-controlled value cookie.
input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No integrity protection around cookie pickle payload.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker-controlled cookie accepted by route.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-003; identical deserialization trust boundary.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Jinja autoescaping does not help because user input is compiled as template source.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Flask/Jinja route reachable.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same render_template_string source construction as MAINPY-004.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No fixed template or variable binding is used.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker can submit name field.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-004; identical Jinja template-source injection.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No parameter binding. try/except returns errors but does not prevent injection.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Database initialized and route reachable.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same WHERE clause interpolation and cursor.execute sink as MAINPY-005.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No prepared statements or escaping before SQL execution.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Global cursor and query_build initialized by startup.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-005; same source, sink, and affected route.

input_finding_assessments.reachability: Reachable through GET /user with attacker-supplied authentication cookie.
input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Audience, issuer, and time checks exist, but algorithm selection is attacker-controlled and includes None/HS256.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker can craft token satisfying accepted verifier path and claims.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same JWT algorithm dispatch flaw as MAINPY-006. Severity differs between reports, but implementation evidence is the same.

input_finding_assessments.reachability: Reachable through GET /user with authentication cookie.
input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Manual verifier performs claim checks but accepts untrusted alg-driven None/HS256 paths.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Token claims must satisfy audience, issuer, time, and sub requirements.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-006; both trace token cookie to alg dispatch to admin-state check.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: html.escape occurs after parsing and does not constrain DTD/network/resource resolution.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: lxml/libxml2 behavior and deployment resources determine exact disclosure/SSRF effect.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same unsafe parser settings as MAINPY-007. Static route-level weakness is confirmed; exact runtime effect remains a candidate.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Parser configured with no_network=False, load_dtd=True, huge_tree=True.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Exact file/network impact depends on runtime and deployment.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-007; both identify the same XML parser configuration path.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Only app_ keys are linked, but decrypted selectors are checked against all CONFIG keys; errors are returned.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker can send chosen ciphertext and observe response differences.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same AES-CBC decrypt/unpad oracle as MAINPY-010.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No authenticated encryption or generic error handling.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker can repeatedly query /config.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-008; identical crypto selector path.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: HTML is built by string concatenation; no template autoescaping for these outputs.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Victim renders attacker-influenced response in browser.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same raw HTML reflection as MAINPY-008, but MAINPY-008 adds /listservices as another affected path. Consolidated finding preserves expanded evidence.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: No consistent escaping of user, token, DB, or exception text.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Attacker controls reflected value or causes reflected error/data content.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate class and same root control failure as BF-009, with additional route evidence in /listservices. Consolidated as one raw HTML output-encoding issue with multiple paths.

input_finding_assessments.reachability: Startup path runs when PRIVATE_KEY_FILE and PUBLIC_KEY_FILE are absent.
input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Environment-supplied key files avoid generation, but default fallback writes predictable temp paths and logs them.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Same-host or log-reading actor; temp ACLs/log exposure determine practical exploitability.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same startup key storage issue as MAINPY-009.

input_finding_assessments.reachability: Startup fallback reachable when key env vars are not set.
input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Explicit env key files are a mitigating configuration; fallback remains present.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Host filesystem/log access determines exploitability.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-010; same predictable temp key material path.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Cookie expiry is set, but Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite are omitted.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: User logs in and browser stores authentication cookie.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Same auth cookie flag issue as MAINPY-011.

input_finding_assessments.controls_and_mitigations: Bearer cookie is trusted later by /user, but security attributes are absent.
input_finding_assessments.conditions_required: Browser-based authentication flow.
input_finding_assessments.dedup_reasoning: Duplicate of BF-011; same set_cookie call and auth cookie trust.

candidate_assessments.reason: Unsafe parser options are source-confirmed, but exact external entity/file/network behavior depends on lxml/libxml2 and deployment controls.
candidate_assessments.next_step: Validate parser behavior in the supported runtime or document deployment-level parser/file/network constraints.

candidate_assessments.reason: Predictable temp key write is source-confirmed, but exploitability depends on host ACLs, process isolation, and log exposure.
candidate_assessments.next_step: Review deployment filesystem permissions and log exposure for generated key paths.

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: OS command injection in DNS lookup
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: address is concatenated into os.popen command

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: Pickle deserialization of client cookie
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: client cookie is decoded and passed to pickle.loads

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: Server-side template injection in greeting route
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: user input becomes Jinja template source

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: SQL injection in listservices category filter
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: category parameter is interpolated into SQL

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: JWT algorithm confusion and None acceptance
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: untrusted JWT alg header controls verifier and admin claim is trusted

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: Unsafe XML parser configuration
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: untrusted XML parsed with DTD loading, network enabled, and huge_tree

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: AES-CBC config selector padding/decryption oracle
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: chosen ciphertext is decrypted and distinct errors are returned

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: Raw HTML rendering of attacker-influenced values
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: response HTML is assembled by concatenating unescaped values
deduplicated_logical_findings.dedup_note: MAINPY-008 expands the affected paths to include /listservices; this is related and consolidated because the same missing output-encoding control is reused.

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: Predictable temporary JWT private key storage
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: startup fallback writes private.pem to predictable temp path and prints it

deduplicated_logical_findings.title: Authentication cookie missing Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite
deduplicated_logical_findings.common_root_cause: set_cookie omits security attributes for bearer JWT cookie

related_but_separate.relationship: All can lead to process authority but use different vulnerable operations, sources, and controls; they should remain separate.

All affect authentication or token exposure. JWT algorithm confusion, private key storage, cookie hardening, and XSS are distinct controls but can combine in larger token-forgery or token-theft paths.
/listservices has both SQL injection and raw HTML rendering/error reflection. The same route is involved, but the database query integrity control and output-encoding control are separate.
Unsafe XML parser settings are confirmed statically; exact XXE/SSRF/file-disclosure behavior is a runtime-dependent validation candidate.
